rows.label: A
rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following to the FAA for review: - 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating Endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include a detailed summary of the history of the condition; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up. - 2. Copies of any testing already performed by the treating physician (e.g., labs, imaging).
rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following to the FAA for review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating Endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It must include a detailed summary of the history of the condition; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 2. Copies of any testing already performed by the treating physician (e.g., labs, imaging).
